purpose: Editable collection artwork; no tokens are minted by this tool.
historicalNote: Fictional, stylized appearances. Euclid and Cleomenes are not authenticated portraits. Visual colors and costumes are art direction, not NFT rarity assignments. Five artwork variants do not allocate the five historical-figure token copies.

characters.title: Alexander, the conqueror
characters.summary: Born to royal kin, a commander who reached the rank of general and earned a recorded military distinction while still young.

stage.title: Field camp
stage.description: A modest campaign tent, supplies and a small campfire.

stage.title: Officer quarters
stage.description: An organized camp with a timber shelter and a planning table.

stage.title: Command pavilion
stage.description: A substantial command pavilion with a campaign map and stone defenses.

stage.title: General headquarters
stage.description: A fortified residence with a broad courtyard and an imposing command hall.

stage.title: Royal palace
stage.description: A lavish palace with monumental gold-trimmed columns and a ceremonial dais.

characters.title: Aristotle, the philosopher
characters.summary: A widely read teacher of argument who tutored students or advised the court and left a remembered philosophical work.

stage.title: Humble study
stage.description: A simple reading desk beneath an olive tree.

stage.title: Private study
stage.description: A small scholar’s room with manuscript shelves and a writing table.

stage.title: Teaching courtyard
stage.description: An established teaching court with benches and a stone colonnade.

stage.title: Lyceum complex
stage.description: An extensive scholarly garden with multiple lecture colonnades.

stage.title: Court library
stage.description: A magnificent royal library with carved columns and illuminated manuscript cabinets.

characters.title: Euclid, the geometer
characters.summary: A careful reckoner and reader who worked among tables and demonstrations and left a credited piece of scholarship.

stage.title: Sand-tray courtyard
stage.description: A small courtyard with a sand tray for simple geometric demonstrations.

stage.title: Geometry workroom
stage.description: A dedicated workroom with a diagram board and a few book rolls.

stage.title: Geometry school
stage.description: A flourishing school with large diagrams and demonstration tables.

stage.title: Museum hall
stage.description: An imposing scholarly hall with tall shelves and geometric instruments.

stage.title: Grand library
stage.description: A monumental library with gilded arches and a ceremonial geometry floor.

characters.title: Cleomenes of Naucratis, the grain administrator
characters.summary: A trader or court official with a head for accounts who grew rich and closed recorded commercial agreements.

stage.title: Market storehouse
stage.description: A modest grain stall, a small storehouse and a trade balance.

stage.title: Merchant warehouse
stage.description: An expanded warehouse with organized grain sacks and shipping records.

stage.title: Revenue office
stage.description: A formal accounts office overlooking the granary quay.

stage.title: Administrator residence
stage.description: A grand official residence with a courtyard overlooking the grain harbor.

stage.title: Treasury hall
stage.description: A lavish treasury and administrative palace with gilded architecture and grain reliefs.

characters.title: Scholar of Alexandria
characters.summary: A teacher took you in hand for a season and drilled your letters. A reader lent you a book roll and talked it over with you.

characters.title: Soldier of Alexandria
characters.summary: A veteran took you under his wing and taught you to keep your footing. A soldier warned you that the recruiters were coming, so you put food and silver aside.

characters.title: Trader of Alexandria
characters.summary: A merchant extended you credit on easy terms when you needed it. A trader hired you for a season of paid work at the quays.

characters.title: Craftworker of Alexandria
characters.summary: A workshop master took you on and taught you the trade's first skills. A craftsman shared part of a paid commission with you.

characters.title: Stargazer of Alexandria
characters.summary: An interpreter of the sky read a favourable omen for you. A sky-watcher warned of a hard year, and your household stored food against it.

characters.title: Performer of Alexandria
characters.summary: A musician's playing lifted your spirits through a hard week. A troupe of performers lent your household a hand when it was struggling.
